description: Synthetic Artifact Store cases. Test harness creates bytes/temp paths and computes real hashes at runtime.

cases.name: publish-small-task-output
cases.fixture_bytes: synthetic markdown bytes generated by test harness

cases.name: same-publication-id-retry-is-idempotent
cases.setup: publish pub-001 successfully, then repeat exactly the same finalize request after simulating response loss

cases.name: publication-id-reuse-conflict
cases.setup: publish pub-001 successfully, then reuse pub-001 for a different allocation or different finalized bytes

cases.name: oversized-output-fails-before-publication
cases.mutation: candidate staged content size exceeds allocation max_size_bytes

cases.name: media-type-outside-allocation-fails
cases.mutation: request media_type=image/png for an allocation allowing only text/markdown and application/pdf

cases.name: semantic-type-outside-allocation-fails
cases.mutation: request semantic_type=artifact.image@1 for allocation expecting artifact.report@1

cases.name: same-bytes-deduplicate-blob-not-artifact-identity
cases.setup: publish identical bytes through two independent valid allocations/publication IDs with distinct lineage

cases.name: source-path-mutation-after-import-does-not-change-artifact
cases.setup: import temp source file, then change original source-path contents

cases.name: crash-after-blob-placement-before-metadata-commit
cases.fault_injection: process/crash after immutable content blob is placed but before Artifact metadata transaction commits

cases.name: admitted-import-pending-placement-recovers-by-exact-receipt
cases.fault_injection: stop after verified synced import pending bytes and durable exact import receipt, before no-overwrite hard link

cases.name: denied-publication-hard-link-never-becomes-recovery-authority
cases.fault_injection: expire the pinned allocation after pending copy but before hard-link admission

cases.name: legacy-or-path-swapped-pending-file-cannot-borrow-a-receipt
cases.mutation: upgrade an old pending file without a receipt or replace the exact receipted path after verification

cases.name: crash-before-blob-publication-leaves-staging-only
cases.fault_injection: process/crash while allocation WRITING before immutable blob placement

cases.name: metadata-record-with-missing-blob-is-integrity-failure
cases.fault_injection: remove/corrupt immutable blob after a published Artifact metadata record exists

cases.name: provider-cannot-use-arbitrary-final-path
cases.mutation: provider attempts to turn task.output into /home/fixture/arbitrary.txt or blob-store-root path

cases.name: export-path-rename-does-not-change-artifact-id
cases.setup: export same immutable Artifact to two different user-selected paths

cases.name: export-writer-destructor-before-success
cases.setup: trusted destination writer has a destructor that appends a visible test byte

cases.name: export-destructor-denied-after-revocation
cases.mutation: revoke exact egress grant after finalize but before destructor entry, then drop the destination
